factChecks.note: Traced via three independent zoomed crops (diode band/lead identification, battery terminal identification, and the connecting wire paths), not inferred from the label. The diode's cathode (marked by both the physical band and an explicit '-' text mark) connects via the top wire path to the battery terminal that is NOT the explicitly marked '+' terminal (i.e. the '-' terminal, by elimination). The anode (unmarked lead) connects via the bottom wire path to the battery's explicitly marked '+' terminal. This means anode is connected toward '+' and cathode toward '-' -- which is FORWARD bias wiring, the opposite of what this asset requires and the opposite of what its own 'REVERSE BIAS' label and blocked-current (X) arrows claim.
